approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for the government's ongoing operations.
It would provide money for the ordinary annual services of the government, as required by sections 53 and 54 of the Constitution.
The bill covers the remaining seven-twelfths of the 2022-23 financial year's estimated annual appropriations, excluding new Budget measures.
Appropriates funds from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for ordinary annual services.
Allocates spending across government portfolios according to the Administrative Arrangements Order that started on 1 July 2022.
Provides the remaining seven-twelfths of estimated annual appropriations for the 2022-23 financial year.
Government departments and agencies receiving ordinary annual services funding.
